Hello everyone! Here's my new public short story of the month... "Succubus Party." Almost all our favorite succubi are back, having gradually spread throughout a certain area of ​​the city. Now, one of the newest members decides to invite her friends to a party at Madame Wine's mansion. Both girls accept, unaware that this party will change their lives completely!
